final_message: Fixed by preserving initializer source positions when generating default providers for both `@Builder` and `@SuperBuilder`. Lombok previously assigned nested calls the same position, colliding with javac 11’s position-based type cache. Peeky’s `peeky probe` at `JavacHandlerUtil.java:178` showed both calls reset to `node.pos = 45`. Added regression coverage without modifying existing tests.
